brief: A bicycle icon for an icon set: one line weight, black strokes on transparent, no fill, 24×24 grid, simple and readable at small size.
A logo for a student spring exhibition. The words "Kevadnäitus 2027" must appear exactly, with the ä. Two colours, bold and playful, works on white.
A square geometric pattern tile, 200×200, that repeats seamlessly when tiled: shapes that cross an edge continue on the opposite edge. Three colours, inspired by Estonian folk knitting.
A flat vector illustration of a red fox standing in a birch forest: white birch trunks with dark marks, autumn ground, simple shapes, no gradients.
Tee SVG tulpdiagramm Tallinna keskmistest temperatuuridest: jaanuar −3, aprill 5, juuli 18, oktoober 7 (°C). Iga tulba juures kuu nimi ja väärtus, pealkiri „Tallinna temperatuurid“, nulljoon nähtav.

An A-format portrait poster layout (viewBox 0 0 600 850) for an art academy open day. Big bold typography. Text in Estonian, exactly: "Avatud uste päev", "14. märts, 12–18", "Põhja pst 7, Tallinn". Only three colours, strong grid, geometric shapes.
An animated SVG (SMIL or CSS inside the SVG, no JavaScript): three coloured circles orbiting a centre point, each at a different speed, looping forever.
Joonista lihtne lapsik maja lumisel talvemaastikul: punane maja valgete akendega, korstnast tõuseb suits, ees kuusk. Ukse kohal silt „Tere tulemast“. Tasased värvid, ilma üleminekuteta.
